description: nomenclature is a Python package for managing project definitions in the Integrated Assessment Modeling Consortium data format. The IIASA README links documentation and a release DOI and says the package works with controlled variable and region templates. Users provide scenario tables and project definitions; the package checks names and structure before comparison or publication. Coverage depends on the IAMC scenario domain and region list supplied. The README states Apache-2.0 licensing. A limitation is that a well-formed variable name does not establish that a scenario is physically feasible or that values are comparable across models. The package can check energy, emissions and land-use scenario inputs used in infrastructure transition simulations. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model produces energy scenarios; nomenclature checks scenario definitions, not solving an energy optimisation. No tables or package were downloaded.
name: nomenclature IAMC scenario-definition checker
